blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-ops-2 (A dropped webhook is logged only with console.debug, in free text) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Wait between attempts with an exponential backoff and jitter (for example 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, 8 s, capped), or better, hand failed deliveries to a scheduled retry queue so the spacing can span minutes. The retries are bounded and the operation is idempotent (merchants deduplicate on `x-event-id`); only the spacing is missing.
findings.title: Failed deliveries are retried immediately, with no backoff

findings.recommendation: Log the final drop with the project's structured logger at error level — `logger.error("webhook delivery dropped", { eventId, paymentId, merchant identifier, attempts, lastStatus or lastError })` — and count drops in a metric an alert can watch, so an operator sees lost notifications and can replay them.
findings.title: A dropped webhook is logged only with console.debug, in free text

findings.recommendation: Log every failed attempt through `logger.warn` with fields — eventId, attempt, the HTTP status for a non-2xx response or `String(error)` for a network error or timeout — so an operator can tell a merchant returning 401/404/500 from a timeout.
findings.title: Non-2xx responses are retried without any log, and attempt failures are free text
